# Direction Cosines To Euler Angles

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Extract three zero Euler angles from the identity direction-cosine matrix with the displayed rotation order.

Extract three zero Euler angles from the identity direction-cosine matrix with the displayed rotation order.
